runtime: pywrangler dev / wrangler local Workers runtime, WebAuthn/passkey scheme
worker_log_secret_scan: no master/HMAC/TOTP/token material in worker logs
scope_notes: Validated through the real local Python Workers runtime (pywrangler dev / wrangler), not mocks.
Enrolment used a soft-authenticator producing real WebAuthn attestation objects (CBOR/COSE) and assertions (authenticatorData + clientDataJSON + DER ECDSA).
No physical phone/browser ceremony was performed; browser-side WebAuthn behaviour is standards-defined but manual device testing is still recommended before production enrolment.
UV enforcement, RP binding, challenge binding, revocation, admin operations, exactly-once delivery, and the TOTP non-bypass invariant were all validated live.
